outcome_summary: Blocked alive after repeated sentry staging and no-progress recovery
outcome_reason: Fallback stopped after 128 accepted waits without observed gameplay progress
improvements: After a connection failure, the bot discards stale game information and does not automatically repeat actions that might already have happened. It retries startup observations only when no action was sent.
When a full backpack prevents a pickup, the bot leaves the item unfinished without treating its square as impassable.
incoming_learnings: A verified underfoot pickup refusal is not evidence that occupied ground is impassable. Preserve honest loot obligations and hazard checks; reopen ordinary collection after inventory changes without granting acquisition or descent credit.

review.review: The recording ended blocked, alive at full health, not dead or clock-frozen. Decisions 640–642 (log lines 1840–1847) show sentry staging to cell 1446, exploration back to 1404, then staging back again. The initiating mismatch is in tools/puzzle_supplies.py: stage_sentry accepted a hypothetical protected reward route without the unknown-potion test-bank gates used by prepare_supplies. The selected bank is six cells from the sentry, beyond the existing five-cell test limit, and also fails safe_test_bank beside observed statues. Thus arrival cannot produce the intended test. Repeated staging later competed with descent and triggered navigation recovery; fallback eventually consumed 128 advancing waits without progression. Final accepted transitions show the clock advancing, with HP 30/30. Offline reconstruction against the played source matched actions and reasons for decisions 0–642 using recorded public observations and accepted-input bookkeeping; this is reconstructed memory, not recorded runtime memory. The candidate first differs in selection reason at decision 633 and reconstruction stops there. A focused correction now applies the existing test-bank gates before unknown-supply sentry staging; known-haste staging remains unchanged. The new three-test regression fails on original policy with the evidenced staging action, passes on the candidate, and the full suite passes 1419 tests with four skips. No potion identity, protected crossing, reward acquisition, safe replacement route, or eventual descent is established.
review.learnings: Before committing to puzzle staging, require compatibility with the next action’s existing admission checks. A hypothetical protected reward route does not establish a safe unknown-potion test. Preserve unfinished loot and mandatory progression pickup; never infer protection or collection from movement.

recommendations.summary: Require unknown-supply sentry staging to satisfy the existing potion-test bank gates.
evidence: Decision 1074, accepted transition at log line 3154
recommendations.reason: Patch passed isolated validation and was accepted.
